evidence.supports: RETFound pretrains on CFP/OCT and adapts to ocular and systemic disease tasks.
RETFound improves ocular disease diagnosis and prognosis across internal and external evaluations.
Systemic disease prediction uses CFP/OCT and reports AUROC across internal and external cohorts.
Reconstruction and RELPROP saliency show retinal anatomy and disease regions in CFP/OCT.
External dataset/device shifts, UK-dominant cohorts, separate modalities, and missing covariates remain limits.
